Your email arrived 2 days ago, so the 3-day reply window hasn't quite closed. If you don't reply within 3 days of that email, the fern ($80) is automatically refunded. You can still reply before then to choose a similar plant of equal or higher value, wait up to 14 days for the fern, or take the refund.

The out-of-stock options and refund apply only to the fern, so the pot isn't cancelled by this. Our policy doesn't say whether the pot ships separately or waits for a replacement plant, so I can't promise a ship date. I can escalate to a Support Lead to confirm that if you'd like.
